adaptive_rule.block_permutation: At each update and each100 new assignments, deterministically SHA256-permute the fixed quota using study vector hash, generation, update, block and position. Assignment hashing consumes no policy/minibatch/environment RNG. Record policy share used, assignment ordinal, horizon, generation, update, block, frame attribution, seed identity and hash.
adaptive_rule.boundary_rule: At each successful completed-update boundary, use cumulative audited exposure through that update. If full-game-assigned frame share >=0.70, assign exactly30 short-stage and70 full-game horizons per next100 newly constructed normal episodes. If share <0.70, assign0 short-stage and100 full-game horizons per next100. Apply only to episodes constructed after the boundary; in-flight assignments never change.
adaptive_rule.guarantee_limit: This is a feedback target, not a mathematical guarantee of future realized frame share: policy death behavior can make even full-game-assigned episodes short. It cannot guarantee age>1000 exposure if policy does not survive. Report realized age-bin frames separately from assignment quota.
adaptive_rule.initial_mix: For update1, assign all newly constructed episodes to full-game horizon18000; this gives a full-game-only initial exposure observation.
adaptive_rule.mastery: Keep current registered gates: at least10 complete updates in generation, at least200 completed eligible stage-horizon episodes, and two consecutive nonoverlapping windows of100 eligible completions each with >=90 successes; promote at most once per update boundary after all rows are processed. Only current-generation episodes assigned current-stage horizon count. Full-game episodes count at stage18000 only.
adaptive_rule.measure: Cumulative audited raw gameplay frames, including fatal frame, attributed by frozen episode assignment to short-stage horizon versus full-game horizon. Exclude startup frames. Update exposure is complete only after its PPO step succeeds.
adaptive_rule.stage_horizons: 1000*(generation+1), generation0..17. Short stage assignment includes full normal-start prefix and truncates only at assigned horizon. Full-game horizon18000 is ordinary cap. Earlier-age practice recurs through normal starts.
adaptive_rule.starvation: When measured share is below floor, short-stage assignments are suspended; when at/above floor, maintain30% stage assignments. Log zero-assignment/zero-completion stages. Never force-reset, jump frames, drain, extend, or change active episodes.

adaptive_curriculum.budget: 6 runs, 983040 decisions/run; at most7680 Adam steps/run. No added validation rollouts. Training mastery uses only in-run completed episodes and is not an independent evaluation.
adaptive_curriculum.controls_reuse: May share a fixed-70/30 control only if parent proves same parent lineage, sampler, vectors, config/runtime pins, decision/optimizer budget, exclusions and evaluation cohort; otherwise run matched independent controls. Never share the opening-seed-priority sampler control implicitly.
adaptive_curriculum.deviation_for_parent_decision: Initial floor is operationalized as an update-boundary feedback target. Realized frame floor cannot be guaranteed under unknown episode duration. The minimal rule needs exposure attribution in the adapter but no inner policy-evaluation/development cohort.
adaptive_curriculum.hypothesis: A feedback rule that suspends short practice when realized full-game-assigned frame share falls below70% may protect later-age exposure while retaining stage practice when exposure floor is met.

observed_baseline.interpretation: Existing fixed70/30 pilot produced50.30% of audited raw frames from full-game-assigned episodes. Adaptive target raises this realized full-game share to>=70% when exposure feedback permits. Does not imply70% of frames occur after age1000; survival remains policy-dependent.

adaptive_curriculum.parent_and_training: Same accepted324 parent, reward, model, PPO, update count, raw-frame cap, normal starts, full six-field matched vectors, batch size64, 256 decisions/update, 60 updates and sample/optimizer limits.
adaptive_curriculum.semantics: Use accepted runtime's existing terminal/truncation semantics: true death wins even on horizon; death terminal does not bootstrap; alive practice cutoff truncates and bootstraps actual final observation; no death penalty at practice cutoff; ordinary18000 alive cap remains unchanged.

If rank1 seed-priority study's priority-sampler constant-LR arm matches every parent, vector, sampler, budget, code/runtime and endpoint contract, parent may register an explicitly cross-study paired comparison using those exact control receipts plus three linear-schedule runs (additional2949120 decisions). Otherwise do not reuse controls.
learning_rate.endpoint: All run update60 policies; each study gets unique parent-reserved fresh1024 full-game cohort. No intermediate best-of-N selection.
learning_rate.fallback: No arm advancement on missing/failed step, metric, schedule counter or receipt. Preserve partial receipt; no retries, replacement seed, budget top-up or endpoint substitution.
learning_rate.hypothesis: A linear 3e-5 to1e-5 schedule may reduce late-update movement; evidence is cross-domain and does not establish Dodge benefit.
learning_rate.optimizer: Restore accepted full Adam state. Before first override, require every restored param-group LR equals schedule(t=1). Do not reset Adam or moments. Before each PPO update, set every param group to expected lr(t), verify exact effective LR, construct per-update PPOConfig with that same LR, then run PPO. Checkpoint/integrity save records effective LR and schedule index. Resume/replay validation recomputes LR from global local update; never demand a hard-coded constant LR for every update.
learning_rate.per_update_formula: lr(t)=3e-5 + (1e-5-3e-5)*(t-1)/59, integer t=1..60; update1 exactly3e-5, update60 exactly1e-5.
learning_rate.unchanged: Same parent/model/Adam restore, six-field paired vectors, update/decision budget, gamma/lambda, epochs4, minibatch512, targetKL.03, optimizer epsilon1e-5, clipping/entropy/value coefficients, reward and sampler within each pair. Only LR schedule changes.
